Hi all,

Thanks for the context, Marissa. High level guidance from Legal below: 

1) Preferred sequencing: NDA signature first (mutual or our standard), then DPA + MSA redlines in parallel. NDA clears the way for sharing more sensitive artifacts (SOC2 reports, infra diagrams).

2) Turn time estimates (our side):
- NDA: 3-5 business days for review and counters; we can fast-track to 24-48 hours for standard mutual NDAs if the customer asks.
- DPA: 10-12 business days to propose Redwood standard changes (depends on privacy comments).
- MSA: 2-3 weeks for a standard commercial/technical redline cycle (longer if there are material commercial concessions).

3) Redline sequencing recommendation: 
- If Acme is sharing a MSA template, we typically: (a) exchange the NDA; (b) legal teams exchange MSA/DPA redlines (we can do simultaneous redlines to avoid blocking); (c) finalize DPA earlier if data handling is the gating factor.

4) Logistics: please send Acme our Redwood_Standard_NDA_v2.pdf if you prefer us to propose language. We support DocuSign for execution. If Acme prefers to start with their MSA template, please attach it here (done) and we will begin redlines.

Marissa — I’ll review Acme_NDA_v1.pdf and send proposed redline/comments to Samantha directly; copying Ben and Rishi for visibility.

Thanks,
